title: Close out the 2026-10-27 codebase simplification programme: measured per-wave reduction, plan status correction, RC coverage
goal: All thirteen simplification waves (S1 x2, S2 x6, S3 x3, S4 x2) merged between 2026-10-27 and 2026-10-28, but the programme was never closed out: docs/reviews/CODE_SIMPLIFICATION_PLAN.md still declared itself unexecuted at line 6 and asserted at line 302 that no production source had been touched, the programme packet's completion checklist was entirely unchecked, and the programme manifest's linkage pointed at an evidence directory that had never existed. This package removes that contradiction: it rewrites the plan's status into an execution record, aggregates the thirteen waves' measured diff stats into programme evidence, re-measures the four structural metrics the plan defined, enumerates RC coverage (32 of 45 covered, 13 explicitly deferred), and states the one remaining programme item - the pantheon-ops build against a foundation release - as a maintainer-gated gap instead of an omission. No source code, workflow, dependency, route, permission code or migration changes.
findings: CODE_SIMPLIFICATION_PLAN.md:6 and :302 described the programme as unexecuted after all thirteen waves had merged, so the plan document contradicted both the wave evidence and the repository itself.
The programme packet's Completion Checklist had no boxes ticked and its runtimeGap still read 'No wave has started', even though every wave manifest was completed.

.harness/evidence/2026-10-27-codebase-simplification-program/ did not exist although the programme manifest's linkage.reviewFile and linkage.summaryFile pointed into it, leaving a permanent 'Linked review file does not exist' warning from check:task-packet.
No programme-level measured net reduction existed; each wave recorded its own git diff --stat but nothing summed them or compared them against the audit's -1,500 to -2,100 line estimate.

in: Rewrite the plan status line and closing disclaimer, and add an execution-record section with the thirteen-wave measured table
Create .harness/evidence/2026-10-27-codebase-simplification-program/ with commands.json, summary.md and review.md so the programme linkage resolves
Re-measure the plan's four structural metrics and the two LOC windows against HEAD
Enumerate RC coverage and the deferred set
Tick the programme packet checklist items that are verifiable and keep the pantheon-ops build item open with its reason
Register the doc-status-drift failure mode as FR-020 and add the matching ratchet rule to AI_QUALITY_GOVERNANCE.md section 5.3
out: Any backend or frontend source change
Marking the programme manifest completed before the pantheon-ops build item is verified
Cutting a foundation release or touching pantheon-ops
Changing gate thresholds, workflows or checker behaviour
Deciding the final disposition of RC-036, RC-037 or RC-038 against the S4 keep decisions

implementationNotes: Per-wave numbers come from the wave evidence's recorded git diff --stat, not from the audit estimate and not from squashed commit stats, because several squash commits bundle adjacent waves' evidence files.

The LOC window from 96ef1d66 to HEAD also contains tenant feature waves, the plan-ladder change, the release-notes move and the S3776 fix, so it understates the simplification drop; the summary states this instead of presenting the window as the programme's gain.

Coverage is counted by RC id: a wave summary or docs/reviews/GOVERNANCE_SURFACE_DECISIONS_2026-10-27.md naming the id counts as covered; the plan's explicit 'not in this round' table counts as deferred, and the two sets must not be merged.
The programme manifest stays in-progress: its checklist item 'pantheon-ops builds against the synced foundation release' cannot be satisfied without a maintainer release cut.
